metadataRaw.title: How to Get Rid of a Pinched Nerve in Your Lower Back
metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe demonstrates simple exercises that can provide fast relief from sharp, shooting pain caused by a pinched nerve in the lower back.

These exercises are designed to help reduce pressure on bulging and herniated discs—common causes of pinched nerves and sciatica—while promoting healing and improving mobility.

For the best results, perform all of the exercises and focus on the ones that provide the greatest relief.

Watch now and start relieving lower back pinched nerve pain today!

Chapters: 
0:00 Intro
0:37 Bed/Floor Exercise
3:01 Bed Exercise
5:47 Standing Exercise
8:31 Decompression Exercise
9:54 Strengthening Exercise
